新增 skill-vetter 审核规则说明；新增 self-improving-proactive-agent 安装后配置持续运行的说明

config-new-agent 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces automated workflow for adding and configuring new agents in OpenClaw.
- Detects agents without bindings and assists users in creating group bindings for Feishu.
- Guides users through peer ID collection, configuration review, and binding confirmation.
- Installs required skills (skill-vetter, skill-finder-cn, self-improving-proactive-agent, openclaw-tavily-search) into each new agent’s dedicated workspace.
- Enforces strict workspace isolation rules, especially for self-improving-proactive-agent skill data.
- Ensures no modifications are made without user review and gateway restart confirmation.
